title: Slim leaves for Frank Painia and the lawsuit; Irma Thomas and Chris Kenner
summary: Slim signed with Shaw before Stovall's contract ended; a suit recovered about $4,000. Stovall names Slim as his biggest recorded artist.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
